name: @mathjax/src
description: Beautiful and accessible math in all browsers. MathJax is an open-source JavaScript display engine for LaTeX, MathML, and AsciiMath notation that works in all browsers and in server-side node applications. This package includes the source code as well as the packaged components.

scripts.clean:dir: clean() { pnpm --silent log:single "Cleaning $1 directory"; pnpm rimraf $1; }; clean
scripts.clean:lib: clean() { pnpm --silent log:single "Cleaning $1 component libs"; pnpm rimraf -g components/$1'/**/lib'; }; clean
scripts.clean:mod: clean() { pnpm --silent log:comp "Cleaning $1 module"; pnpm --silent clean:dir $1 && pnpm --silent clean:lib $1; }; clean
scripts.copy:assets: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Copying assets'; copy() { for name in locales mj2 mml3 html; do pnpm --silent copy:$name ${1:-mjs}; done; }; copy
scripts.copy:html: copy() { pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying sre auxiliary files'; pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/a11y/sre/*.html' 'ts/a11y/sre/require.*' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales: copy() { for name in core tex mml menu util a11y adaptors; do pnpm --silent copy:locales:$name ${1:-mjs}; done; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:a11y: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying a11y locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/a11y/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:adaptors: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying DOMAdaptor locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/adaptors/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:core: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying core locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/core/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:menu: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying menu locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/ui/menu/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:mml: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying MathML locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/mathml/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:util: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying utility locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/util/*/__locales__/*.json' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:locales:tex: pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying TeX locales'; copy() { pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/tex/__locales__/*.json' $1 && pnpm copyfiles -u 3 'ts/input/tex/*/__locales__/*.json' $1/input/tex; }; copy
scripts.copy:mj2: copy() { pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying legacy code AsciiMath'; pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/input/asciimath/legacy/**/*' $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:mml3: copy() { pnpm --silent log:single 'Copying MathML3 extension json'; pnpm copyfiles -u 1 ts/input/mathml/mml3/mml3.sef.json $1; }; copy
scripts.copy:pkg: copy() { pnpm --silent log:single "Copying package.json to $1"; pnpm copyfiles -u 2 components/bin/package.json $1; }; copy
scripts.cjs:build: pnpm --silent log:header 'Building cjs'; pnpm --silent cjs:src:build && pnpm --silent cjs:components:build
scripts.cjs:compile: pnpm --silent cjs:copy:components && pnpm --silent cjs:copy:ts && pnpm --silent cjs:compile:tsc
scripts.cjs:compile:tsc: pnpm --silent log:single 'Compiling cjs typescript files' && pnpm tsc --project tsconfig/worker-cjs.json && pnpm tsc --project tsconfig/cjs.json
scripts.cjs:components:build: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Building cjs components'; pnpm --silent cjs:components:src:build && pnpm --silent clean:dir bundle-cjs && pnpm --silent cjs:components:make --build
scripts.cjs:components:clean: pnpm --silent log:single "Cleaning cjs components"; pnpm rimraf components/cjs
scripts.cjs:components:compile: pnpm --silent log:single 'Compiling component files'; pnpm tsc --project tsconfig/components.json
scripts.cjs:components:finalize: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Finalize cjs components'; pnpm --silent cjs:components:copy && pnpm --silent copy:pkg components/cjs && pnpm --silent clean:lib cjs
scripts.cjs:components:make: make() { pnpm --silent log:single 'Making cjs components'; node components/bin/makeAll --cjs --terse --bundle-cjs $1 $2 $3 components/cjs; }; make
scripts.cjs:components:src:build: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Building cjs components sources'; pnpm --silent cjs:components:clean && pnpm --silent cjs:components:compile && pnpm --silent cjs:components:finalize
scripts.cjs:src:build: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Building cjs sources'; pnpm --silent link:src && pnpm --silent clean:dir cjs && pnpm --silent cjs:compile && pnpm --silent copy:assets cjs && pnpm --silent copy:pkg cjs
scripts.cjs:copy:components: pnpm --silent log:single 'Moving cjs files from components' && pnpm copyfiles -u 2 'components/mjs/**/*.cjs' 'components/mjs/**/*.d.cts' components/cjs
scripts.cjs:copy:ts: pnpm --silent log:single 'Moving cjs files from ts' && pnpm copyfiles -u 1 'ts/**/*.cjs' cjs
scripts.mjs:build: pnpm --silent log:header 'Building mjs'; pnpm --silent mjs:src:build && pnpm --silent mjs:components:build
scripts.mjs:compile: pnpm --silent log:single 'Compiling mjs typescript files'; pnpm tsc --project tsconfig/mjs.json && pnpm tsc --project tsconfig/worker.json
scripts.mjs:components:build: build() { pnpm --silent log:comp 'Compiling mjs component files'; pnpm --silent clean:lib mjs && pnpm --silent clean:dir bundle && pnpm --silent mjs:components:make $1 && pnpm --silent mjs:bundle:finalize; }; build
scripts.mjs:components:make: make() { pnpm --silent log:single 'Making mjs components'; node components/bin/makeAll --mjs --terse --locale ${1:-en} components/mjs; }; make
scripts.mjs:src:build: pnpm --silent log:comp 'Building mjs sources'; pnpm --silent link:src && pnpm --silent clean:dir mjs && pnpm --silent mjs:compile && pnpm --silent copy:assets mjs
scripts.mml3-xslt: pnpm --silent mml3:pre:xslt && pnpm --silent mml3:make:xslt && pnpm --silent mml3:post:xslt
scripts.lab:sre: pnpm --silent log:single 'Making lab/sre'; node components/bin/makeAll --terse lab/build
scripts.link:src: pnpm --silent log:single 'Setting symbolic link'; node components/bin/link-full
scripts.clean: pnpm --silent clean:mod cjs && pnpm --silent cjs:bundle:clean && pnpm --silent clean:mod mjs && pnpm --silent clean:dir bundle
scripts.make-cjs-components: make() { pnpm --silent cjs:components:make $1 $2 && pnpm --silent cjs:bundle:finalize; }; make
scripts.build-all: build() { pnpm --silent build-mjs $1; echo ; pnpm --silent build-cjs $1; }; build
